title: Complaints of Defects in New HDB BTO Flats
what_it_is: Complaints of Defects in New HDB BTO Flats

sections.label: BTO defect feedback and rates
sections.summary: About 90% of defect feedback came during the DLP, with reported defects per BTO flat averaging 2.6 then dropping to 0.2, 0.1 and 0.05.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Based on BTO flats completed over the past five years, about 90% of the feedback on defects was received during the DLP, with the remaining 10% received in the second to fifth year following the blocks’ completion.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: On average, during the DLP, the number of reported defects per BTO flat was around 2.6 and this dropped significantly to 0.2 after the first year, 0.1 after the second year and 0.05 after the third year.

sections.label: HDB warranty periods for defects
sections.summary: HDB gives new flat owners a five-year warranty for external wall or inter-floor seepage and a 10-year warranty for spalling concrete.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition, HDB provides all new flat owners with a five-year warranty for external wall seepage or inter-floor seepages, and a 10-year warranty for spalling concrete.

sections.label: Contractor to replace cracked toilet seats
sections.summary: HDB met building contractor Precise Development Pte Ltd, which agreed to replace a number of defects related to cracked toilet seat covers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: HDB met up with the building contractor, Precise Development Pte Ltd, and the contractor agreed to replace, in this case, I think a number of the defects related to the cracked toilet seat cover.

sections.label: Seepage covered by five-year warranty
sections.summary: The Member's question concerned residents having multiple repair attempts over years for seepage, and seepage carries a five-year warranty.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The question as framed by the Member was where the residents have multiple attempts at repairs and this continues over many years with respect to seepage, I understand.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, if it is seepage, then there is a five-year warranty.

sections.label: Developer responsibility and warranty limits
sections.summary: A developer cannot be responsible for a building's entire lifetime, so new flat defects follow the DLP and seepage and spalling concrete have a 10-year warranty.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Because it cannot be that a developer remains responsible for the entire lifetime of the building which is subject to fair wear and tear.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, if it is a new flat and there are defects, that will be followed up on, general rule – DLP; seepage, then the warranty for the seepage, spalling concrete, that is a 10-year warranty, which is a really long time.

sections.label: Tender decisions and contractor information
sections.summary: Asked whether that information set is weighed in awarding tenders to contractors, the speaker said the information was not available and declined to answer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Is that information set analysed and given some weight in the decision-making process to award tenders to contractors?

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I do not have that particular information with me at the moment and hence, I do not want to hazard an answer, and inadvertently, not give correct information.

sections.label: HIP defects liability period
sections.summary: The passage states that since an HIP project ended, liability periods have come up, but circuit breaker prevented works from being dealt with.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
sentences.text: Yes, I think since the end of an HIP project that perhaps was completed at the end of last year or somewhere where during the COVID-19 period, we have had the liability periods come up.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, meaning it is already into the defects liability period, but because of the circuit breaker, the works could not be dealt with?
